QUOTE: The interface contract (`include/entropic/inference/tokenizer.h:55`) says "empty on failure or empty input." Those two cases look identical to every caller.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that failure and legitimately empty input are indistinguishable, and its caller table shows that callers (e.g. `do_count_tokens`, the generate paths) do not check for it.
